title: Bit to Integer Converter
text: 将位向量映射到对应的整数向量，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Output data type} 指定输出数据类型 Inherit via internal；{Number of bits per integer(M)} 指定每个整数的位数、{Input bit order} 指定输入位顺序 MSB、{After bit packing, treat resulting integer values as} 指定位打包后有符号整数值的标志，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 bit scalar | column vector of bits

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 integer | column vector of integers

params.name: Number of bits per integer(M)
params.values: 每个整数的位数 3 (default) | integer in the range [1, 32]

params.name: Input bit order
params.values: 输入位顺序 MSB first (default) | LSB first

params.name: After bit packing, treat resulting integer values as
params.values: 位打包后有符号整数值的标志 Unsigned (default) | Signed

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest integer | Same as input | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
